review_description: Excellent customer service, installer was amazing left the place clean and tidy. I highly recommend. Even after the installation was completed the customer service has been great, getting back to me quickly answering all my questions. I highly recommend green.com.au
The quote and sales person was good - enough to pay more than other quotes.The installation team were polite and tidy.Customer service were polite and helpful.
The Sales people were very professional and answered all my questions and quarrels patiently.The installers were professional and tidy.

Everything from the sales / quoting process to the installation was a breeze. The installers were punctual, tidy, polite and answered several questions. We received help with app installation on site and a tutorial for app settings etc during a follow up phone call with Green.com.au

I was initially worried as my first install date was cancelled on the day and I didn’t receive a new date for a couple of months. Every time I reached out there was a reply email the next day. The second install date was 2 mths after the first, this time they arrived on time and left the worksite clean and tidy. I was set up with my app and 24hrs later noticed the batteries stopped charging at 69%. Another email overnight and I received 2 phone calls and an email to help fix the problem. I had a query about the instructions and rang Green. Immediate customer service, very helpful,   easy fix, no need to get installers back. Happily watching my batteries fill from my solar to use when the sun goes down.

The guys (and gals) at Green are top notch. After being referred onto them by the one and only John Cadogan, the guys at Green took over the design & installation of the solar system & battery, as well as taking care of the carbon credits and associated paperwork. They provide top quality REC panels from Norway and Tesla Powerwall for storage. They were so good and easy to deal with, that I had a second Powerwall battery added by them recently. So, these guys are not your dodgy cows boys installers, but legit people delivering the goods without any hassle involved.

My husband and I are so pleased to have  chosen Green for our battery purchases.The whole order and installation was handled by Green  without any unnecessary input from us. The sales team are courteous and professional and their installers were the same. We were guided through the app installation and the rubbish removed . All happened in a good time frame.We really couldn't have expected  better.Thankyou Green.

The battery install was so smooth. From the first contact, to the quote, to acceptance the process was perfect.We were always kept informed, advised along the way without us chasing any details.The installer was incredible, totally professional and set us up on final installation.
Easy to deal with slight delay in getting batteries due to stock levels, but as soon as they gave me a date it was locked in and easy.

Iinstallation and communication problems, including  discrepancies between what sales promised (location of the batteries, I checked three times that it was ok) signed ($19,000!!) proposal, paid deposit and customer service said NO to sales confirmed location.Delays and miscommunication confirmation on revised location, following many calls and emails. Still outstanding.Now 7 weeks post signed proposal and no battery location confirmation or install date in sight.They’re now not answering calls.

With so many providers seeking customers, I found Green to be very easy to deal with. Their pricing was lower than expected and the hardware is of very good quality (also Google reviewed).The installation was down in two stages as we were building a new home and the panels were installed without distracting the builder. The batteries and inverter were delayed due to supply shortages but regular contact was maintained and was installed at a time already planned.Connection to the grid and after installation support was appreciated.

Sales were great to deal with and polite on the phone and did not try to push the sale installers I could not fault easy to deal with and removed all rubbish even when I suggested they could put in my bin great job by them all highly recommend

Green.com.au was highly professional from the first quote until the end of installation. Phone calls returned, questions answered and install timely after contract signed. Install went very smoothly , follow up phone call and informative email. A professional job that I would highly recommend.

Right from the start I was impressed with Green.com.au sales team. Friendly, informative, and most importantly didn't say anything negative about other quotes we had received ( all other companies I called seemed to think this was the way to get our business...no thanks)We did have a bit of a glitch with installation date being organized and communicated but eventually got sorted out.The actual installation was flawless and professional and we only wish we had it installed earlier. The app is very easy to use too.So far very happy ( also had a blackout 2 days after installation and all worked perfectly that we needed)

We all know this process is daunting, with a limitless supply of options available.Almost none of us are experts in the field, as such we somewhat rely on advice and gut during the buying process.After my crash course on loads, phases, yields and battery types, i settled on Alpha Ess thru Green.com.au.My average daily usage hovers around 24kwh, and i already had a 10kw PV array with 3 phase inverter.I looked at an extended list of options in the 20-30kwh battery size, with both single and three phase hybrid inverters.I received quotes from around $5k thru to $15k, and settles with Alpha Ess somewhere in the middle.After an approx 8 weeks wait install occurred.I was given a heads up, and the boys arrived on time, and completed in about 5.5 hours.I was apprehensive about the systems space and encroachment on parking, however i was greeted withan incredibly neat and slim profile set up, even with the mandatory bollards in place.This allows me to retain use of my double garage without issue.I have been accustomed to the Fronius app and smart meter, but am glad to say that the Alpha Ess app and its use is simple and intuitive.It includes full cost basis data, load, output, SOC etc........im a big fan.All up, couldn't be happier, given the potential pitfalls and perils with such a purchase.The Green.com.au team were easy to deal with, and offer a wide selection of kit, if Chinese Batteries are 'not your schtick'.I would be happy to recommend them and Alpha Ess to anyone looking for a mid tier system at a good price and service to match!

The quoting process was friendly and not a hint of pushiness; willing to negotiate.  It was not the cheapest quote that I have received for the same system but they gave me the most confidence in following up (should there be any).  Every member that I spoke to has their face on the Green website - which shows me they are willing to put a face to their word and work.The installation went well and the installer checked everything meticulously. I was consulted prior and during the install to that I know what's been done and if I had any objections to the plan. The system was tested in front of me to ensure that it worked before they shut it down to await for the Inspector.
Very tidy tradesperson. Good communication through the process. Customer service after has been helpful

The sales person was amazing explained everything and answered all questions clearly and simply. Installation went great even though it pretty much rained the whole time he was here he kept going and git the job done. At the end of installation he helped get the app all set up with me and explained how everything worked. I could not fault any of the people I dealt with through the whole process. Great experience

Really happy with the whole process. My only side note, being 3 phase home, being offered/recommended a larger inverter to maximise use of the system would have been nice, but the system installed is great and I can already see the benefits.

Excellent experience from start to finish. Initial discussions with Ryan were friendly and informative providing me with everything I needed to make a decision to proceed. The operations team kept me well informed as the process worked towards completion. On installation day Wade and his team installed and tested the batteries and dealt with some minor issues before leaving the areas they worked in looking neat and tidy. Wade also answered all questions I asked with clarity showing he was very skilled in the installation process. After installation the operations and services team happily assisted with any questions I had and were demonstrably had well developed knowledge of the technology. The system is operating very well and its capabilities exceed my expectations.
Green arrived on time and did a great job installing the battery system. They were quick, cleaned up after themselves and showed me how to install and use the app.

Very efficient sales / quoting process. Needed to send information and photos online which they assisted in instructing us as not all that tech savvy. Braithwaite our sales agent patiently guided us through the process.Time line was given and adhered to. Our installer Shakeb and his team were well organised, efficient, tidy and patient in his explanation to us and happy to answer our questions. The company did all required paperwork work and organised the grid connection.

After reading positive reviews I was ultimately drawn to Green.com.au by their five year service warranty.From the very first call with Green's support staff I was convinced to go with them. The battery deal, which came in the form of an Alpha ESS 26kwh system, was way better than I had expected (those govt incentives are pretty powerful).The installation was seamless, despite having to overcome some unusual placement difficulties (the batteries are big!), and the team led by Steve was exceptionally skilled, helpful and informative. All dealing with the grid connection was done by Green.I have once reached out to the support team for some further information since the battery was installed and, once again, they responded professionally.As for the battery - nearly two weeks in and it is working perfectly and my home is operating at 98.3% self sufficiency.I cannot recommend Green and the Alpha ESS highly enough.
3 quotes allowed us to make an informed decision. Very happy with entire process

From early inquiries, to completion, a great and personal experience.   I stayed in touch with the same Green contacts from initial inquiries to completion of the installation process (Brad, Dominic, Nico).   Our site was a little unusual, and after the initial vist, the installers (Marcus and team) needed to check if the proposed location and method would be covered by warranty before proceeding.   They checked and confirmed, and we made a revised installation time.  Great service, installation took a few hours, and clear instruciotns on use and the APP afterwards.

Many thanks to the Green team for their assistance in our solar battery installation. They were very helpful during the whole process from the quotation stage through to installation.Many thanks also to Mitch and his very helpful team of installers,We would have no problem recommending them for any works for us in the future

Process from start to finish was very professional and couldn’t ask  for better communication and follow up.Workmen like admin very professional, tidy and great communication. Were happy to address our questions.Explained how it worked upon completion and left relevant manuals. The company as a whole took charge of everything start to finish and checked with us that we were happy with workmanship after installation. Would not hesitate recommending them to family and friends. Just waiting on power company to connect to the grid.

Sales was very informative and persuasive. No misrepresentation and quick to seal the deal. As i installed in vic, it took a while to get an installation date.However, some slight hiccups occurred where the installer forgot a cable and then on the second install, realised that a component was missing from the install materials. To be fair the team were very upfront about it and I am fine with it. Just that there has been a slight delay of about a month.

From the sales process through to the installation and follow up, Green.com.au were professional and timely.The install team did a great job, and i am very happy with the result.There was one teething issue which was resolved within a day or so.Very Happy Customer

Right from the very first phone call with Brad to the final install with Shakeb it all went effortlessly.Green kept me informed all the time with regard to install time and whether there were any changes.After initially giving me an installation date was quite surprised when they called me and offered me an earlier date as I knew how busy they were.Showed up on time the day of installation and the guys worked tirelessly the whole time without stopping till the job was done. Treated myself and my home with great respect regularly letting me know how it was all going. Very impressed.When they came for the final inspection, they answered any questions I had and showed me how it all worked.I would definitely recommend Green to anybody.Thanks for the great service.
Was easy to discuss productThe sales team are very informativeMade the process a enjoyable oneI recommend this company
Beautiful work. Very Professional. Great customer service. Very prompt in providing updates
The entire team were great to deal with. There was a small delay outside of their control but they kept me up to date. The installers were incredible. Very happy. Definitely recommend.

The whole experience was about as smooth as it could get.The sales team were courteous, knowledgeable, and knew exactly what needed to be done. They worked with us to ensure we were happy with their proposal. Particular thanks to Graham.Our installer, Richard, was just amazing. Our townhouse is a bit tricky, and Richard had told us at the original inspection it was going to take a full day. He turned up on time, showed his credentials, and then worked like a titan, despite some dodgy Melbourne weather. His work was meticulous, and we have a really clean installation, exactly what we wanted. He was very experienced, so we were confident we'd get a good job, but he exceeded our expectations. He was also courteous and informative, and even stayed late to help us set up the app to see it all in action. An absolute champion.All in all, I can't rate Green highly enough. They kept us informed along the way, despite some supply issues, and I'd be confident they'll do a great job wherever you are, but if you're in Melbourne and you're lucky enough to get Richard, you should be very pleased.Thanks Green.com.au!
Efficient and friendly.Unfortunately didn't install an outlet  as I would have liked. Possibly because of time constraints.The company was very good to deal with.

The sales/quoting process was efficient, plenty of information. The final confirmation was later than I would have liked on the Friday afternoon for a Monday installation.The installer was professional and friendly, also punctual. He made sure that the installation site was permissible by contacting an inspector. He explained how to use the system and answered my questions. The installation is neat and tidy.I am waiting for an inspection to be able to turn the system on, it tested OK.

From our 1st enquiry online to our phone calls and now the installation it has been fantastic.The installation was very smooth and easy the 2 guys were fantastic and very helpful, nothing was a problem.
Easy and responsive sales/quote.Installer was very professional and engaging - able to answer to all of my queries.Great customer service via phone and email.

I used solar quotes before when adding a PV system. It went well but in retrospect should have future proofed it by adding a hybrid inverter. When the battery subsidy came out I got 3 quotes with through solar quotes and green provided the best advice by installing the biggest battery capacity for the 2 seperate pv systems I have.I now have a 26.6 AC coupled AlphaESS battery system. I was worried that earlier reviews wern't glowing but the warranty has been extended and recent reviews have been very high, a credit to Green and the installers. The install went very well and talking to the electrican they were very happy with Alpha. I was stepped through the App personally and after the electrical inspection I was able to use the battery. At first it didn't chsrge higher than 69% so I contacted Green and they gave me a really easy step by step solution. They also followed up to make sure all was well. We now make use of our excess solar and when we had a planned outage we had a full battery to run essential power.

Was installed while I was away .I was meant to be billed after the nsw rebate came in , but things took a turn from there .Green estimated rebate, without the relevant information and billed me early .Now the information is available and I have had 3 other rebates priced well above what Greens estimate was.Still in dispute .In my opinion - the product looks a bit unfinished, even possibly dangerous. See photos

Our installer was sent by the retailer with only a Christian name, date & time frame for arrival. No further correspondence,  however Simon arrived with his team within half an hour of the proposed 7am to 9am start. His team  proved to be efficient, knowledgeable & pleasant. I was shown what switch to use if power to house was cut/scheduled blackout & given the app to check performance. My regret is that I did not question how to input our plan into the Profit checking section of the app. Our plan does not have peak & off-peak times which does not correlate with the app. Difficult to input solar feed in up to 14kWh per day, then over 14kWh per day.

We had our green.com.au solar panels installed late April.We toyed for years as to whether to go solar panels and eventually did.Abby Carbines at Green was great. Patient and full of all the information we needed to get us across the line.The customer service and install process was awesome. The panels also visually look so much nicer than our neighbours if aesthetics matter to you.Bills with Red Energy have definitely been reduced since installing solar, but we're still working out how best to maximise it all.
Great service keep us up-to-date about the installation,  the I stallers did a great job
Customer service was great, Installation was great. Any Problems Quickly solved

After wading through several different quotes and speaking to other providers, we decided to go with Green.com.au for their professional approach and competitive pricing. Sales Agent Tom was helpful and informative with quick follow up to any enquiries and made the purchasing process seamless. Installer Simon, with Liam, did an excellent job and we are very happy with the quality of the product and their work. Support documentation and the App were immediately provided post installation.

Green have been extremely efficient, intelligent and supportive with the quoting and installation of my Sungrow solar batteries. Efficient with the quoting , Government grants and delivery/ installation. Intelligent with the placement, wiring and structuring of the equipment and supportive during the complete process.
Quoting process very professional giving complete information and salesperson very knowledgableInstallation was timely, polite and professional.

Braith was great he literally arranged everything from updating and changing quotes from my requests to arranging grid connection and installation.Really seamless and awesome experience from Green!Keep it up guys!

Having gone through solar quotes I settled on Green.com.au (then known as Teho) as the sales experience was excellent. Install followed quickly thereafter, which included a switch to divert solar for the existing hot water.Turns out the switch was faulty but the experience was exasperating to say the least, it took over a year to finally obtain a refund.Come mid July 2025 I reach out to Green.com.au after noticing a performance issue with the solar. I requested an onsite system health check and agreed to cover the nominal cost on the proviso that it is refunded if a fault is found.At time of writing this review it is now well into September 2025. I have dealt with 3 different team members in the company, emailed numerous times (to which they do not reply) and called multiple times and received just two calls back advising they are working on it/escalating it.So whilst the sales experience is great, the after sales service and support leaves a lot to be desired. Caveat emptor.

Everything went to schedule.Rick, who installed my solar battery had to put in extra time due to some unforeseen complications, but he did so without complaint and left my property tidy. I would recommend Green.com to anyone considering installing a solar battery.

Green kept me well informed of the progress of the delivery of the battery under trying circumstances when battery availability was severely strained. The installation team led by Shakeb were courteous and punctual and explained the system well. In essence, Green did everything they said they would and met the promise on the "tin"!

Very happy with Green during the whole process from start to completion, the installation was done by Christian Gonzales in a very professional way he was very helpful and done a very good job something that not to many people do this day

I have been very happy with the service and installation of my 26kWh Alpha ESS battery from green.com.au. This is to go with existing Enphase panels that I have had for over 5 years.The quoting process was quite straight forward. I was given options of different batteries and different capacities.The installation by Marcus and his team was excellent. Their workmanship and approach was very professional. They did a great job of explaining the system, how it works and setting up the app so I can monitor progress and my savings.

Brad from Green made everything so easy. The communication from Green was fantastic the entire time.The installer was on time, professional and did a great job. Alex who lead the installation also helped me set up the app on my phone which I use daily.Green helped set me up with a loan provider, and the monthly repayments are only slightly higher than what I pay for electricity anyway.Overall I'm very happy I chose Green.

The sales experience was good - no pressure - questions answered and speedy follow-upThe installation was earlier than expected and went without a hitch. The only quibble is that they arrived at 10am and that meant finishing quite late in the dark. We had to go out and leave them to finish the job.The installer assisted in setting up the app with me. They also did a good job of cleaning up after themselves, including removing the old Austar dish.I'm not sure what is meant by "The charger" or if the grid connection is relevant.
Markus and team were prompt. Polite approach; Tidy - no mess left. Gave a thorough explanation of the battery controls and app. use. Installation is well placed and neat.

Green were very good at communicating with us during the entire process. Olivia was excellent, courteous and friendly to deal with. The installers, Matt Lawless and his team were fast, efficient and professional. All-in-all, a very good experience across all facets of the project.

Easy and quick. Installer was informative quite polite and on time with no mess left on his leaving. From first phone call to Installation customer service was on hand at every point even with grid connection.

If you're looking for solar or a battery with a company who doesn't feed you BS, green.com.au is the crew for you.They helped us with all goverment applications, and stayed in contact the whole time. Shout out to Graham who's a green legend.

The whole process was actually enjoyable - being able to work with intelligent professionals who answered questions and followed followed up queries when the person didn't have that info on hand. Full marks to Brad.After quote acceptance Green checked with me regularly to see that the installation process was running on time and their chosen installer (Simon) was beyond reproach. So good to deal with a competent tradesman with no bullshit.
The sales team were great, everything t hey promised came true. The installer worked a 10-11 hour day and still at the end stayed to show me how to use the app. 10 out of 10 would reccomend.

Thank you Brad & Graham in helping me in deciding to make the right choices your polite ease of communication in answering all my questions & your quick responses show your dedication to make sure the instillation ran smoothly.The installation was punctual & your install personnel were polite & tidy & also answered many of my questions.Very happy with the customer service provided during the install & the organising of the grid connection which was only a few days later.

Green were terrific.The sales team were friendly and professional and met all my requirements. Their installer was friendly and flexible to my needs and clear with his explanation how the system worked. Green respected my wishes when I requested changing the installation date and were happy to help me maximise any Government rebates.Thank you so much for recommending them.I'm so glad I went through Solar Quotes

I have a solar system with another company. Which is working well. 7.48 Kw, 17 panels, works well with the batteries.May 1st I bought a 10.1 Kwh battery from green.com.au.  All the staff were great, friendly, polite and they know what they are talking about.All paperwork was done by Green -  connection to the grid. I didn't have to lift a finger. The guys know exactly what is required. Nothing is a issue. I'm so happy to have dealt with them.Before I knew it the battery was in my driveway. Simon and company did a great job. I've had no power bills for 9 months - that's zero. Great feeling.Anyone who is interested in a system.Get in touch with green.com.au, You will not look back.Love ya work guys.
I am happy with both the installation and the products. Everything went smoothly and the installers answered questions and explained how to monitor with the app.

Green have excellent customer service as they're very prompt in their responses and pleasant to deal with.Their knowledge & product quality are also great and I would recommend them to anyone seeking new panels or batteries.

The Green staff were wonderful in helping me through the process of installation of our battery and inverter. A mention to Ashlee who was easy to deal with and informative pre and post installation.Brad Fiedler managed the ordering of the system in a seamless manner and followed up with informative phone calls.Brad, Graeme, Ashlee………..friendly, courteous, pleasure to deal with !
Great customer service from Ryan, and installation was trouble-free. Installers were friendly and helpful.

Big shout out to Ryan Towel and the team at Green Energy.Ryan was knowledgeable and responsive and was able to answer any and all questions that I had. He provided a solution that meet our needs at a competitive price.The operations team were a pleasure to deal with and provided excellent customer service and were efficient in booking in my installation.The installers arrived at the scheduled time and went about the install in a methodical professional manor. They were courteous and very knowledgably answering any and all questions I had and could explain the operation of the battery I purchased extensively. They left the site cleaner than they found it.There was one minor issue discovered after the installer left. Ryan immediately escalated the issue to the operations team who arranged for the installer to return to site to resolve the issue the same day.This gives me the confidence that going forward any issues that I may experience will be resolved quickly, effectively in a professional manor.I will certainly return to Green for any future solar needs and would highly recommend them to anyone considering solar purchases.

I spent a while looking at different solar companies since I had a very specific set of requirements due to having an EV. Green came out far on top. In particular, Ryan from Green had the specialised knowledge to improve on my plans, keep prices reasonable, and help me get the best of all the rebates. The entire green team through to the installer were professional and highly skilled. I actually ended up enjoying the experience.I know how 10.2 kW of solar, an EV fast charger, and a 26 kWh monster of a battery set up and running. Green were really flexible with a roof repair I needed done that kept getting delayed as well. I recommend these guys highly to everyone who asks me about solar.

This time we purchased Batteries for our home.We have used Green previously and again, they outdid themselves in pricing, customer contact and answering queries promptly.The installation went without a hitch, with the workmen cleaning up as they went, and installed the app for the batteries on our phones and explained how it all worked.

Ryan Towle helped by making sure that the system I was buying was suitable for my property and energy usage. Unlike other installers he didn't push me towards an over-expensive system that I didn't need - which I appreciated.After that he answered all my questions and gave me confidence that Green.com.au is a good solar company to go with.The subsequent installation was smooth with all questions answered - and since then the solar system is working perfectly with no problems at all.I would strongly recommend Ryan and Green.com.au for solar installations.

Great customer service, great communication. They deliver when they say and deliver a high quality product. Thanks to Ryan and Nicho at Green, and our installer Jake. Very happy with the whole experience.

From the quotation to installation we could not fault Green. Prices were competitive and quality workmanship ensured a smooth installation process. Installers took their time to clean the site and explain the system to us and ensure all was functioning correctly.I can recommend that Green gave us a trouble free installation and we are enjoying electricity savings going forward

From the beginning with talking to Braith it was a start off a great beginning, the service from the sale's department (Braith) and the service department and the after installation service call,and the installation team was absolutely fantastic, highly recommend Greens Energy very efficient and competitive prices. Thanks Green teamRegardsLou and Sarah

I was impressed with the efficiency from my first contacts. I had wanted to be cautious about the various offers being made and when I chose Green.com.au, the information was clear and the cost competitive. I found staff both in the initial contact and then in the installation friendly and open. the installation went very smoothly and was flexible, given our set up.

Abby was our first contact at Green and she was very professional and helpful. She answered all of our questions and took time to explain things. Peter and his install team were prompt, efficient and tidy. Peter was great on follow up questions I had. We could not be more happy with our system that Green installed!

The sales person sent me a text before calling to check if I was free to talk.  They were excellent at their job, from knowledge of systems to discussion of our needs.  I did not feel pressured at any time to make a decision.When install day arrived the whole team was very polite and respectful, led by a very professional team leader.We discussed placement of the inverter and panels (we have 2 large skylights) and future placement of the battery which will be installed in July so as to get the federal grant as an added bonus. (Total rebates for this system come in at just over $11,000 ?).After taking my very loud barking pup for a looong drive I returned home mid afternoon to find the job complete and one of the cleanest job sites I’ve ever seen.Already producing more power than we draw from the grid during the day and can’t wait till the battery install to cover our power needs in the dark.The only thing I had an issue with was connecting to the internet monitoring, but that’s due to rubbish internet connection at the time.If we need any follow up customer care I trust it will be as good.We are on south coast NSW and tried very hard to engage a local for this job, unfortunately this was not possible.Based on our experience to date, we are confident this larger company has the security to support us into the future and therefore we recommend them highly.

I was happy with Green throughout the process. The energy consultant was very knowledgeable and spent a lot of time and effort to make sure I understood the systems and what I was buying. The installation was fast, neat, and very polite. The customer service team were helpful and communicative in every way, willing to answer questions and make sure we knew what was happening.I would recommend Green to anyone wishing to install solar panels or batteries.

After ringing numerous solar companies for quotes we found Green Solar both cost effective and knowledge to be the bestThe installation was on a date that suited usThey came on time and were very friendly and did the work in one dayThey cleaned up after installing the solars and explained how the system works and how to use the battery powe when there was a blackoutThe installer also down loaded the ISolar Cloud app to my phone and we can see at a glance what the system is doingThat also connected to the grid after installation

We were so impressed with Green.com.au. We purchased a second lot of solar and two more lots of batteries for the house. Now we have 20 kW of solar and 39 kW of batteries. I think to go back for a second time in six months goes to show how well Green.com.au is at solar and batteries. Each time we have dealt with Jack who is great and has helped us out along the way each time and Simon who installed the systems does an amazing job. Both Green and Simon are professional and know what they’re talking about. I could not recommend them enough. The solar panels and batteries that are supplied would be the best around. Thank you, Green and Simon for doing a great job.Jason

Can’t wait to get the system (battery) up and running. Installation went very smoothly, the electricians actually turned up when they were supposed to and just got on with the job. Very happy customer.

Communication was excellent, all questions answered, altered planned panel layout with ease.  Suggested the installer inspect property before hand as not a normal situation. He did so, was grateful for the chance and installation was quick and hassle free. Very professional.

Having recently moved to a house with solar panels already installed, I did some research on how to get a battery connected to them.  Green's was not the cheapest quote, but they had good follow-up and made the process very easy, everything explained and ticked off.  The installer made an invisible connection to the inverter and power box by using already-present conduit from a sub-board, so it hasn't imposed on what is a compact, not to say small, garden area and the battery itself is in the garage, again, not taking up useful space elsewhere. Actually connecting-up has had to wait until the new government subsidies come into effect, but as that will further reduce the cost of installation, I have no complaints, and I'm looking forward to reaping the benefits for many years to come.

Happy with the communication from the get go , they answered any questions we had and provided additional information which was useful in making our decision to purchase a battery. The installation process was also carried out well no issues with tradesmen and they were also very informative when it came to government rebates which ended up saving us thousands of dollars?

I am absolutely thrilled with the recent installation of my new solar battery system from Green. From the very beginning, the process was seamless and professional. The quotation for my 12.2kW Risen Solar Panel, 19 kWh Sungrow battery and 10kW Sungrow inverter was handled remotely with impressive expertise. All of my questions were answered thoroughly and patiently, and I particularly appreciated the complete absence of any high-pressure sales tactics.The installation team was fantastic. They were punctual, incredibly efficient, and worked with a high degree of politeness and respect for my property. The entire job was completed on time, and they left the site clean and tidy. Best of all, the system was fully operational the moment they finished.I couldn't be happier with the result and the entire experience. If you are considering a solar battery system, I wholeheartedly recommend Green for their professionalism, expertise, and exceptional customer service.

They installed our solar system previously, and we’ve now returned to have a battery installed as well. From the first interaction, the team was professional, prompt, and easy to deal with. They took the time to explain everything clearly, making the whole process simple and stress-free.The installation was done quickly and to a high standard. We’re really happy with the result and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to others.

Following my engagement of Manly's Solar Choice, to assist with quotations for solar panel installations, I accepted Green.com to perform my job.
